## loadApprovalGate() function

Load the configured approval provider and build the gate context that governance enforcement consumes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function loadApprovalGate(
  options: LoadApprovalGateOptions
): Promise<LoadedApprovalGate | undefined>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter

</th><th>

Type

</th><th>

Description

</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

options

</td><td>

[LoadApprovalGateOptions](./runtime.loadapprovalgateoptions.md)

</td><td>

The audit writer (required) and an optional registration path override.

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[LoadedApprovalGate](./runtime.loadedapprovalgate.md) \| undefined&gt;

The `{ writer, approvals }` fragment to spread into a governance context, or `undefined` when no provider is configured.

## Exceptions

[ApprovalProviderError](./runtime.approvalprovidererror.md) when a provider is configured but cannot be loaded, or when no usable audit writer was supplied.

## Example

```typescript
import { createMultiServer } from '@macts/api/server'
import { loadActivePolicy, loadApprovalGate } from '@macts/runtime'
import { createFileAuditWriter } from '@macts/core'

const policy = await loadActivePolicy()
const writer = createFileAuditWriter('/path/to/audit.jsonl')
const approvals = await loadApprovalGate({ writer })
const server = createMultiServer(manifests, {
  governance: approvals ? { policy, ...approvals } : { policy, writer },
})
```
